# The Odds API

The Odds API provides real-time sports betting odds data from various bookmakers worldwide, covering multiple sports and betting markets.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/the-odds-api/.

## Actions

- **Get Event Odds** (read-only): Retrieve odds for a specific event.
- **Get Events** (read-only): Fetch live and upcoming events for a specified sport.
- **Get Odds** (read-only): Fetch live and upcoming event odds for a specified sport, including bookmakers, regions, and markets.
- **Get Participants** (read-only): Fetch list of participants (teams or players) for a specified sport.
- **Get Scores** (read-only): Return live and recently completed event scores for a sport.
- **Get Sports** (read-only): Retrieve a list of in-season sports.
